calibration.method: Image distance fit; source: Esri World Imagery z19 mosaic, north-up Web Mercator (lon 74.3012-74.3057, lat 31.4786-31.4836), with OpenStreetMap (ODbL) outlines registered on it; traced 2026-11-20; origin px 851,712.5768380875854; image-to-world rotation 0°
refs: E-W baseline (great-circle distance from the Web Mercator tile georeference, Esri World Imagery z19, as a map ruler measures it): 700,1200 -> 1500,1200 px = 203.48 m
N-S baseline (great-circle distance from the Web Mercator tile georeference, Esri World Imagery z19, as a map ruler measures it): 1100,560 -> 1100,1800 px = 315.394 m
Diagonal baseline (great-circle distance from the Web Mercator tile georeference, Esri World Imagery z19, as a map ruler measures it): 700,600 -> 1500,1800 px = 366.829 m

schematicMap.northDirection: map top = SOUTH. Verified 2026-11-20 against satellite imagery: a 180-degree rotation (not a mirror), so map left = east and map right = west.
schematicMap.author: Abdul Moiez (FAST CS'22)

meta.notes: schematicBoxPx values are [x,y,w,h] pixel estimates (about +/-10 px) on the 1320x891 student map; use for relative layout and labels only. Left/right notes in room lists are relative to an unconfirmed frame. M2 site plan traced 2026-11-20: the walled campus boundary measures about 42,484 m² (about 10.5 acres), below the published 12.5 acres (see OPEN_QUESTIONS #31). M3 defaults boundaryWallHeight (2.5 m) and gateWidth (6 m) are placeholders for rendering until measured (OPEN_QUESTIONS #38).

mapToWorld.formula: X_east = (775 - px_x) * m_per_px ; Z_south = (752 - px_y) * m_per_px
mapToWorld.status: orientation verified 2026-11-20 (180-degree rotation); metric positions come from meta.calibration, not from this not-to-scale formula
